latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of fly-io-deployer.

- Deploy and manage Node, Python, Go, Rust, Elixir, and Docker apps on Fly.io.
- Generates production-ready fly.toml, Dockerfile (if missing), stateful service plans, CI/CD pipeline, and a cost model tailored to real traffic needs.
- Supports migration from Heroku, Render, Railway, and AWS with clear runbooks.
- Handles advanced features: region and replica selection, Fly Postgres clustering, LiteFS replication, Upstash Redis, Tigris object storage, volumes, WireGuard private networking (6PN), secrets, blue/green deploys, scale-to-zero, preview deploys, log shipping, and cost optimization.
- Output includes deploy manifests, scripts for secrets/logs/previews, and detailed platform guidance.
